parsed.summary: The patch adds a `.distinct()` call to the queryset to prevent duplicate options in formfields when using `limit_choices_to` with a Q object. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new method call `.distinct()` which may not align with the existing coding style or conventions in the Django project.
